# Outbound Load Verification and Staging Report
Order Reference: PO-88341-C
Facility: Foxglove Distribution Hub 4, Bay 12
Date: 03/18/2026
Inspector / Operator: Raymond Banerjee
Lead Sign-Off: Sunita Osei
Forklift Unit: Raymond EASI Reach 4,500 lb Capacity (Unit #FL-14)

## Verified Pallet Details
| Pallet ID | SKU | Description | Cases | Weight (lb) | Height (in) | Banding / Wrap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PL-101 | GL-440 | 1 gal Industrial Degreaser | 48 | 2,150 | 54 | Intact / Clear |
| PL-102 | GL-440 | 1 gal Industrial Degreaser | 48 | 2,150 | 54 | Intact / Clear |
| PL-103 | HM-109 | Calcium Hypochlorite Granules | 30 | 1,650 | 48 | Intact / Yellow |
| PL-104 | CS-332 | Nitrile Gloves (Bulk Cases) | 80 | 720 | 62 | Intact / Clear |

## Load Inspection Summary
- Physical piece count matches manifest total of 206 cases across 4 pallets.
- Pallet integrity confirmed: no torn film, broken deckboards, or leaning stacks observed.
- Carrier dock trailer 53-A spotted and wheel chocks verified at Bay 12 by Caleb Lindqvist.
- All placards and Class 5.1 oxidizer hazard warnings are attached to PL-103.

## Staging and Transfer Instructions
- Transfer all four verified pallets sequentially from Staging Aisle 3 to Bay 12.
- Transport PL-101 and PL-102 together on a single double-fork run to accelerate staging.
- Maintain fork height at 4 to 6 inches above ground during travel with mast tilted back.
- Reverse down ramp from Bay 12 when operating without an active load.
- Complete post-loading cargo securement before driver departure.

errors.quote: Transport PL-101 and PL-102 together on a single double-fork run to accelerate staging.
errors.explanation: PL-101 and PL-102 each weigh 2,150 lb, totaling 4,300 lb, and the table lists them as two separate pallets. Moving them together on one run exceeds the safe handling and carriage capability of forklift unit #FL-14 (capacity 4,500 lb rated at standard single-pallet load center) and violates standard single-pallet carriage for high-weight bulk liquid drums/cases.
errors.fix: Transport PL-101 and PL-102 as individual single-pallet loads to stay within carriage limits.

errors.quote: Reverse down ramp from Bay 12 when operating without an active load.
errors.explanation: OSHA 1910.178(n)(7) requires unloaded industrial trucks to travel with the forks pointing upgrade/forward when negotiating ramps; travelling downhill in reverse applies to loaded trucks, not empty ones.
errors.fix: Drive forward down ramp from Bay 12 with forks pointing downgrade only when unloaded, or travel in reverse down ramp when carrying a load.
